---
title: "Events"
# Takes an event out of Upcoming the day after it happens, without a
# republish; it goes into Past only once events.yml marks it attended. See
# js/events.js.
include-after-body: _includes/events.html
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source(file.path(Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", "."), "R", "site.R"))
ev <- site_events()
```

Where to find me, in person and online. If you'll be at one of these, come say hi.

```{r}
#| results: asis
soon <- upcoming_events(events = ev)
if (length(soon)) {
  cat("## Upcoming\n\n")
  for (e in soon) cat("- ", event_item(e), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n")
}
```

## Regulars

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (e in ev$regulars) cat("- ", event_line(e), "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
# Past can be empty now that it needs confirming, so its heading is written
# only when there is something under it, as Upcoming's is.
blocks <- past_events(events = ev)
if (length(blocks)) cat("## Past\n\n")
for (block in blocks) {
  cat("### ", block$year, "\n\n", sep = "")
  for (e in block$items) cat("- ", event_line(e, past = TRUE), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n")
}
# Past events not yet marked attended or not go to the render log, not the
# page. At a terminal the pre-render asks about them first; this covers
# renders with no one to ask, and any it could not ask about, which it says.
note_unconfirmed(events = ev)
```
